{{Quote|Now then. Prison records indicate several Jedi Masters are being held here. Seems they were investigating a&hellip; thing on Voss. Whatever it was, it corrupted them, drove them mad as mynocks. So the Jedi Council sent them here for safekeeping.|Atren|<ref name="Freeing" />}}
A '''vault''' built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and was used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to contain [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had lost their minds and fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] after encountering the entity known as [[Sel-Makor]] on the planet [[Voss]]. Located in the [[Warlord's Deep]] region of the Tomb, the vault was guarded by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Averon]], who remained alone in the vault to tend to his fallen friends. However, during the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Imperial forces invaded the vault on the orders of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Atren]] and slew Averon, freeing the insane Jedi.<ref name="Freeing" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi containment vault appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Imperial Heroic mission "Freeing the Fallen".<ref name="Freeing" />
